title: Hosted API location pledge and compact evidence folio
creator: Elena Park
description:
Problem: Customers want a lightweight, legally-supportable way to assert where their Hosted API requests are routed and retained without needing a full region-lock workflow. Current residency flows are heavyweight (pinsets + attestation exports) and produce large evidence bundles that are slow to generate.

Goal: Ship a "location pledge" UX and backend workflow that lets tenants make a signed, time-stamped pledge (soft-commit) of preferred region routing and retention until a configurable review date. Generate a compact evidence folio (signed manifest + minimal metadata + retention snapshot) suitable for legal/compliance review and automated export on-demand or on cadence. The feature should integrate with existing residency audit exports but be optimized for smaller size and fast generation for self-serve customers.
acceptance_criteria: User can create a 'Location Pledge' from Hosted API settings that declares preferred regions and a retention profile
Pledge is recorded as a signed attestation with timestamp and unique pledge-id visible in tenant audit logs
System produces a Compact Evidence Folio (CEF) that contains: pledge manifest (JSON), hashes of route bindings, retention snapshot, routing-policy version, and a verification signature
CEF generation completes under 30s for typical tenant (<= 10 endpoints) and under 90s for larger tenants (<= 250 endpoints)
Support on-demand download (zip) and scheduled export (daily/weekly/monthly) to S3 or legal mailbox
Automated test coverage: end-to-end pledge creation, CEF generation, signature verification, and download flow
UI shows pledge state (Active, Expiring, Revoked) and next evidence export time
Audit entries link to the exact runtime snapshot (route config id + model variant) used when pledge was recorded
proposed_solution: Add a 'Location Pledge' modal in Hosted API tenant settings. When a tenant signs a pledge, the control plane captures a read-only snapshot of routing affinity, retention profile, and active model variant ids; computes SHA256 hashes for each artifact; stores the snapshot in the tenant ledger and emits a signed attestation (KMS HMAC + signature). The Compact Evidence Folio aggregates the minimal snapshot files into a single zip with a top-level manifest.json and a detached signature file. Provide an API endpoint for CEF generation and a console action for immediate download. Hook existing residency export pipeline as a fallback for full evidence if customer requests a deep export.
rollout_plan: Week 1: Design polish + security review for signing scheme (Confluence doc: /confluence/residency/pledge-design)
Week 2: Backend API for pledge create/list/revoke + CEF generator service (feature flag behind 'pledge_opt_in')
Week 3: Console UI + scheduled export worker + automated e2e tests
Week 4: Beta with 5 tenants (compliance-heavy customers) and collect feedback
Week 5: Iterate on performance and size of CEF, expand to GA if no critical issues
comments: 2025-02-15 Elena Park: Initial spec posted. Legal asked for a minimal signed bundle so reviewers don't wade through full exports.

2025-02-20 Marcus Chen: Engineering feasibility check complete. KMS signing + HMAC for verification is the preferred approach. We will reuse the existing audit ledger storage and append pledge entries.
2025-02-24 Design feedback (Priya R.): Add a 'soft vs hard pledge' toggle — soft means preference (no enforcement), hard means reject cross-region route assignments (requires infra change).

2025-02-27 Security review (Amit S.): Clarified that we must support customer-managed KMS for Private deployments. For hosted, use internal signing key and rotate daily. Add signature verification SDK snippet to the folio manifest.
2025-03-01 QA (Rafael): Found an edge case where pledged retention didn't capture TTL overrides from per-route settings; added unit test and bugfix in PR #7284.

2025-03-02 Marcus Chen: Performance profiling shows CEF creation median 12s for 50 endpoints. Need opt to omit verbose route descriptions to hit 30s SLA for 250 endpoints. Marking as focused optimization in sprint.
